column3: Close to the Hebrew.
NKJV renders the consonants read in the Hebrew as “strangers” as “winnowers,” and “lay waste her land” as “empty her land.”

The Hebrew reads “let not the archer bend his bow, and let him not lift himself up in his armor”; NKJV reads the word as “against” and renders “Against her let the archer bend his bow, And lift himself up against her.”
